from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BeginningCashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents balance at the beginning of the period as reported in a filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The registrant/company name this filing belongs to")
    beginning_cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The beginning cash and cash equivalents balance as a numeric value")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date this balance corresponds to")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the cash balance figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    beginning_cash_balances: list[BeginningCashBalance]
